parties: Nxt-Infra Trust (issuer) and institutional investors (subscribers); NovaaOne Capital Private Limited and Ambit Private Limited (lead managers)
headline: Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advises on Nxt-Infra Trust ₹700 crore institutional placement of units
sum: Nxt-Infra Trust, an Actis-backed InvIT holding six road assets spanning 2,000+ lane km, completed a ₹700.15 crore institutional placement to strengthen capital structure. CAM acted as sole counsel to the Trust and lead managers on the issuance.
implication: The institutional private placement route for InvITs demonstrates the capital-raising flexibility of the InvIT structure post-listing; this placement mechanism allows sponsor-backed trusts to issue additional units without public offer formalities, subject to SEBI disclosure protocols.
detail: <cite index="1-3">Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas advised Nxt-Infra Trust and lead managers NovaaOne Capital Private Limited and Ambit Private Limited as sole counsel on the issuance of units by way of an institutional placement to institutional investors, for an amount aggregating to ₹7,001.50 million.</cite> <cite index="22-3">The Trust has an initial portfolio of six Project SPVs comprising 14 road stretches spanning an aggregate length of over 2,000 lane kilometres, located across Delhi, Haryana, Uttarakhand, Uttar Pradesh and Maharashtra.</cite> <cite index="22-1">Nxt-Infra Trust was registered as an Infrastructure Investment Trust with SEBI under the InvIT Regulations on November 8, 2023 and is sponsored by Actis Highway Infra Limited.</cite>

framework.ref: Securities and Exchange Board of India (Infrastructure Investment Trust) Regulations, 2014
framework.note: Core regulatory framework governing the structure, issuance, listing, and investor protections for InvITs; defines institutional placement disclosure and allotment requirements.

framework.ref: SEBI Infrastructure Investment Trust Regulations, 2014 - Regulation 23 (Issuance of Units)
framework.note: Sets out conditions and process for additional issuance of units post-listing, including valuation methodology and institutional placement mechanics.

framework.ref: SEBI Listing Regulations, 2015 - Chapter VI (Institutional Placement/QIP framework, adapted for InvITs)
framework.note: Applicable procedural framework for placement disclosures, lead manager appointments, and compliance with stock exchange norms.
Provides the legal foundation for Nxt-Infra Trust's registration as an irrevocable trust; governs trustee duties and beneficiary rights.

framework.ref: Income Tax Act, 1961 - Sections 10(23FC), 80IA (as applicable to InvIT distributions)
framework.note: Defines tax pass-through treatment of distributions to unit-holders and tax incentives for InvIT-sponsored infrastructure.
Applies to Catalyst Trusteeship Ltd (InvIT trustee); governs trustee registration and fiduciary duties.

framework.ref: National Stock Exchange (NSE) - Listing Agreement for InvITs
framework.note: NSE exchange listing and disclosure obligations for listed units, including placement announcements and insider trading rules.

framework.ref: Companies Act, 2013 (insofar as it applies to Project SPVs and sponsor entity)
framework.note: Governs the corporate structure of the six Project SPVs that form the underlying asset portfolio.

structure.consideration: ₹700.15 crore (₹7,001.50 million) in aggregate unit issuance price
conditions: Institutional investor subscription as per placement offer
Regulatory compliance with SEBI InvIT Regulations
structure.novel: Institutional placement by a privately-placed InvIT post-listing demonstrates capital-raising flexibility; the involvement of NovaaOne Capital and Ambit as co-lead managers signals institutional confidence in the Actis-backed road asset portfolio.

triggers.law: SEBI Infrastructure Investment Trust Regulations, 2014 - Reg. 23(1)
triggers.note: Mandatory pre-issuance approval by Board and compliance with valuation/pricing norms for institutional placement of InvIT units.

triggers.law: SEBI InvIT Regulations, 2014 - Regulation 20 (Disclosure to Stock Exchange)
triggers.note: Requires immediate disclosure of institutional placement outcome (allotment, subscription) to NSE and BSE.

triggers.law: Securities Contracts (Regulation) Rules, 1957 - Rule 19 & Insider Trading Framework
triggers.note: Compliance with insider trading norms and trading window closure during placement period.
